name: Lucia Open 2016

venue.name: [Elektronen](http://www.kungsbacka.se/Uppleva-och-gora/Motesplatser1/Fritidsgardar/)
venue.details: The brown building with disco lights outside.

information: A small and cozy competition in the small town Kungsbacka . A one-day competition open for everyone. Participation fee: 150 SEK. Registration is not accepted until the registration fee is paid. More information about registration/payment can be found under payment Initial limitation of contestants is 35. Registration closes latest December 2nd or when the limit is reached. There are many resturants and grocery stores close to the venue. It's a great opportunity to go Christmas Shopping and on Sunday you could visit the theme park "Jul på Liseberg" in Gothenburg.
